description: An expander that selects any step of a Gegenees or a Hydra directly, one trigger input per step; a Gegenees goes immediately to its left and a Hydra immediately to its right

inputs.text: A trigger here selects that step on the connected switch; where two arrive at once the higher numbered step wins

notes: The expander does nothing on its own: it has to be placed beside a Gegenees or a Hydra, and it can serve one of each at the same time, driving both.
The arrow lights show which steps are available: they follow the Steps knob of the connected switch, pointing left for a Gegenees and right for a Hydra.
